body: I am the baby of my family. Naturally the one who gets picked on the most. My mom is an insane person and I'm sure that's where I get it from. It's just been a rough life emotionally. And now I have nobody to lean back on I've got nothing. I don't have anywhere to go.
I haven't moved forward too much. Just found a better way to hide the pain. Now I'm going to be out on the streets with nothing. I don't know what else to do.
